issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException instead of encoding read-only-ness in the type system or failing at construction.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. A KnnVectorsFormat that may-or-may-not write, decided at call time by an exception, is a runtime substitute for a static guarantee. Either introduce a ReadOnlyKnnVectorsFormat base, seal the class, or throw from the constructor pointing at Lucene104 — don't let SPI hand out instances that explode only at first index flush.

issues.description: Constructor still accepts numMergeWorkers and mergeExec that the read-only format validates then discards.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. The fields were removed but the signature still takes the parameters and runs the executor null-check. The API lies: callers pass data that has no effect. Drop the parameters from the constructor, or document explicitly why a read-only format retains execution-policy arguments.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated rather than imported from its source of truth.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. The constant was previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat; the move introduces a fresh copy with no compiler-enforced link binding the two values. Two independent sources of the same magic number governing on-disk layout is exactly the smuggled coupling that defeats local reasoning. Re-import the original or document that the legacy format intentionally froze its own copy.

issues.description: Public API surface (NAME, QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT, calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval) demoted to package-private without a deprecation cycle.
issues.detail: These were public symbols on a previously-released format. Demoting them in the same release that relocates the class is a hard ABI break for external code referencing them by name. Leave the symbols public-and-deprecated for one cycle before removal, or external readers of old segments break at link time.

issues.description: Protected fields on OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues silently demoted to package-private while the class stays public abstract.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. The class is still public abstract, so external subclasses could exist; quietly stripping protected breaks them with no explanation and only works because the RW test shim sits in the same package. Either mark the class final/sealed, restore protected deliberately, or document the new inheritance contract.

issues.description: Test-only RW format reaches into package-private state instead of using a documented extension hook.
issues.detail: Two reviewers flagged this. Lucene99RWScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat depends on package-private rawVectorFormat, flatVectorScorer, confidenceInterval, bits, and compress to reconstruct writer behavior — an undeclared contract that one production rename silently breaks. Expose a protected createWriter() hook on the production class so tests override a stated seam rather than reach across visibility.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the relocation to backward_codecs is the right direction but the patch loosens structural discipline in ways that need tightening before landing. Three issues drew unanimous flags: read-only-ness encoded as a runtime UnsupportedOperationException rather than in the type system or at construction, a constructor that still accepts numMergeWorkers/mergeExec it silently discards, and DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT duplicated instead of imported from its source of truth. Visibility narrowing of previously-public symbols in the same release is an undeclared ABI break, and protected-to-package-private demotions encode a fragile place-oriented coupling with the test shim. Consensus: NEEDS-WORK — ideally split into pure-move, visibility/deprecation, and write-disable patches.
